title: Northflank warns of security breach affecting AI API keys
excerpt: Cloud hosting platform Northflank urges customers to rotate credentials following a security breach that led to abused AI API keys.
body_html:
Cloud application hosting platform Northflank has issued a warning to its customers following a recent security breach. The incident resulted in unauthorized access to and misuse of customers' artificial intelligence API keys stored on the system.

In response to the unauthorized activity, Northflank is advising all users to immediately rotate every credential and secret that was stored on the hosting platform.
